items: Breezy Summer Fabric, All-Day Comfort—Made from a breathable blend of 70% Rayon and 30% Linen, these pants are the essence of summer comfort. The lightweight, airy fabric keeps you cool and feeling fresh even on the hottest days. Designed to be your go-to for warm weather, offering unparalleled ease whether you’re relaxing or on the move.

Effortlessly Flattering Wide-Leg Design—Featuring a universally flattering wide-leg silhouette and an adjustable drawstring elastic waist, these pants are designed to celebrate all body types. The flowy, airy drape is both incredibly comfortable and inherently stylish. This versatile piece effortlessly pairs with virtually any summer top, from simple tanks to elegant camisoles.

Your Go-To Pants for Every Summer Vibe—Seamlessly transition between lounge, casual, and vacation modes. Pair them with a straw hat, sandals, and a woven tote for an instant beach or seaside getaway look. For running errands, style with a camisole and slides. At home, wear them with an oversized tee for a put-together yet breathable outfit. Perfect for coastal settings, beach outings, and creating your ideal summer moments.
Easy Care—for best results, we recommend machine washing it in cold water inside a laundry bag. Tumble dry on a low heat setting and avoid using bleach.
